summary: Summoner Wars is a fast, tactical head-to-head card game where each player commands a unique faction, summoning units onto a shared battle grid to destroy the enemy summoner. Games are quick, aggressive, and full of card-based combat tricks and positioning.
praised: Good production quality in the second edition
criticised: Luck from dice/card draw can swing combat
Some factions felt unbalanced at launch
Can feel swingy in short games

interaction.kind: open conflict on a shared grid
interaction.detail: Both players' units occupy and fight directly on the same battlefield, with attacks, movement, and card play constantly affecting the opponent's board state. There is no parallel play; nearly every action is a direct confrontation.

scoring.how_you_win: There is no point tally; you win the instant your units destroy the enemy Summoner (or another rare special condition triggers), while defending your own.
scoring.score_note: win by destroying enemy summoner, no score kept
